        int wordInPar = 0, max_length = 0;
        
        for (size_t i = 0; i < Str.length(); i++) {
            char S = Str[i];
            if (S == '_') {
                if (par == 0) {
                    max_length = max(max_length, count);
                } else if (count > 0) {
                    wordInPar++;
                }
                count = 0;
            } else if (S == '(') {
                par = 1;
                max_length = max(max_length, count);
                count = 0;
            } else if (S == ')') {
                par = 0;
                if (count > 0) {
                    wordInPar++;
                }
                count = 0;
            } else {
                count++;
            }
            if (par == 0) {
                max_length = max(max_length, count);
            }
        }
        
        cout << max_length << " " << wordInPar << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
